## PART A - CReating VECTORS:

```{r}
scores <- c(88, 92, 79, 95, 84)

subject <- c("Math", "Science", "English", "History", "PE")

scores
subject
```

```{r}
odds <- seq(1,19, by = 2)
the <- seq(1,5, length.out = 5)

odds
the
```

```{r}
rep(("A"), 4)
rep(c("A", "B"), each = 2)
rep(c("A", "B"), times = 2)
```

##QUESTION #2

```{r}
rep(c("A", "B"), each = 2)
rep(c("A", "B"), times = 2)
```
each repeats every individual element sequentially before moving to the next.
times repeats the entire vector as a whole block.
Would you like to see how these two arguments behave when they are combined together in a single function call?

```{r}
seq(1,2, by = 2) > seq(1, 20, length.out = 5)
```
